name: Frame Data
summary: Shows each fighter's action state, frame, hitlag and hitstun, and who is plus after every hit or shield.
author: PascalPatch

settings.label: Frame advantage after hits and shields

changes: Shield advantage was 3 to 6 frames too harsh: the defender counted as free as soon as shield hitlag ended. It now waits for shield stun to end (checked frame by frame: Dr. Mario's jab is -10 on shield, not -13).
